title: Law to require fire-safe charging rooms for e-bikes in apartments
summary: This bill would remove the current exception that lets residents store and charge up to five personal mobility devices, like e-bikes, inside individual apartments in larger residential buildings. Instead, such devices would need to be charged and stored in a dedicated facility built to Fire Code safety standards, unless only a single device is charged while its owner is present. The change responds to a rise in lithium-ion battery fires, which caused 12 deaths and 83 injuries citywide as of November 2026.
